    Package index

    Compositions

    Compositions use measured spectral bands and disclose their selections and display domains. Supported singleton or repeated selections can reduce to a single-band result.

    hsa_mandala()
    Radial Spectral Mandala
    hsa_spectral_flux()
    Cumulative Spectral Change
    hsa_fusion()
    Multi-Band Spectral Fusion

    Descriptive summaries

    Exact spectral density and experimental RMS slope and equal-band quartiles; descriptive quantities with stated sampling assumptions.

    hsa_spectral_density()
    Spectral Density
    hsa_spectral_gradient()
    RMS Spectral Slope
    hsa_spectral_quartiles()
    Within-Pixel Spectral Quartiles

    Rendering provenance

    hsa_provenance()
    Inspect Original Rendering Provenance

    Appearance

    A theme for image panels, and colour ramps restricted to those that are monotonic in lightness so ordering survives greyscale printing.

    hsa_theme()
    A Theme for Hyperspectral Figures
    hsa_palette()
    Perceptually Uniform Palettes for Spectral Imagery
